title: Bowling
heading: One good bowl and suddenly everyone is competitive
intro: You say you are just having a bit of fun. Then somebody gets a strike and it is game on. UK bowling makes a cheerful stop for families, friends or a rainy afternoon. Browse the venue guides, choose your session and check the arrangements for your group. Add a meal nearby if you fancy making more of it. There is always time for a bit of friendly scorekeeping — and somebody will be telling you about their best bowl afterwards.
